notes: WordPress/Divi theme site. Successfully extracts 10 listings with title, location (as categories), and description. Price information is embedded in description text. URL and image fields appear to be JavaScript-rendered and return null with static HTML scraping - would require Playwright/Selenium for full extraction. Location field contains comma-separated categories (e.g., 'Buy,Exclusive,For Sale,New Jersey'). Prices mentioned in description can be parsed from text.
